body.name: Whitened joint covariate--residual score
body.construction: For even \(n\ge N_0\), let \(d_{ni}=S_{xx,n}^{-1/2}x_{ni}\), \(b_n=S_{dh,n}=S_{xx,n}^{-1/2}S_{xh,n}\), \(s_n=\sqrt{v_n}\), \(r_{ni}=\{h_{ni}-\bar h_n-b_n^{\mathsf T}d_{ni}\}/s_n\), and \(q_{ni}=(d_{ni}^{\mathsf T},r_{ni})^{\mathsf T}\). Define \(Z_n(w)=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n(2w_i-1)q_{ni}=(D_n(w)^{\mathsf T},E_n(w))^{\mathsf T}\).
